actions: Oct 23: launched three new free tour video ads: a long cut, a vertical cut and a second long cut.
Oct 27: updated the media on four free tour ads; all four passed review and are live.
Oct 27: turned off the 10.7.26 proving ground free tour ad set.

campaigns.campaign_name: GCAC |Free Tour| On FB Lead Gen Campaign

insights.creative: The longer free tour video brought 17 leads at $6.52 and the vertical video 11 at $9.32. Both open 'Lombard families have been walking through our doors for nearly 50 years. Come see why,' list two heated pools, eight racquetball courts and a sauna, and offer one free tour with nothing to sign. Worth testing a second long tour video, since the longer cut brought leads cheaper than the short vertical one.
insights.doing: CRM leads were 26 at $8.79 each, up from 9 at $25.57 the week before, on $228.66 of spend.
insights.look_into: Meta counted 28 leads and the CRM 26, a normal gap. One of the three new free tour video ads spent $13.61 with no leads yet, so it is worth watching next week.
insights.next: We recommend keeping the two free tour video ads that brought the leads live, and moving budget away from the third version if it still has no leads next week.
